refnamediv.refpurpose: Returns the events that were last reported for the watcher

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
public arrayIo\Poll\Watcher::getTriggeredEvents
Returns the events reported by the last call to Io\Poll\Context::wait that returned this watcher. A call that does not return the watcher leaves them unchanged.
Io\Poll\Event::Error and Io\Poll\Event::HangUp can be reported even though they are not among the watched events.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns a list of Io\Poll\Event cases, in the order in which the enum declares them, or an empty &array; if the watcher was never triggered.
